cards.cmds:
npm ls --depth=0
npm audit
jq .dependencies package.json
rg import src

cards.title: Design a release performance smoke test
cards.when: Use this when a JavaScript or TypeScript release needs a quick design check that the built app starts and responds.
cards.cmds:
jq .scripts package.json
npm run build
npm run test:smoke
ls -lh dist/index.html

cards.title: Fix a failing Rust unit test quickly
cards.when: Use when a single Rust unit test fails after an edit.
cards.cmds:
cargo test parse_rejects_empty
cargo test parse_rejects_empty
cargo test

cards.title: Make a flaky Rust integration test stable
cards.when: Use when a Rust integration test fails intermittently without changing code.
cards.cmds:
cargo test --test integration
rg -n sleep .
cargo test

cards.title: Fix missing error context in a Rust command
cards.when: Use when a Rust binary panics or returns an opaque failure during execution.
cards.cmds:
cargo run --bin app
rg -n unwrap .
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test

cards.title: Repair borrow checker errors in a Rust module
cards.when: Use when cargo check reports lifetime or borrow ownership errors in a Rust file.
cards.cmds:
cargo check --all-targets
cargo check --all-targets
cargo fmt --check

cards.title: Check dependency name in official registry
cards.when: You need to verify the exact package name and repository link before adding it.
cards.cmds:
npm view express
npm view express repository

cards.title: Audit dependencies without executing install scripts
cards.when: You must check security vulnerabilities before actually installing the package.
cards.cmds:
npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
npm audit

cards.title: Verify dependency licence compatibility
cards.when: You need to ensure the package licence matches the project licence.
cards.cmds:
npm view express license
cat package.json

cards.title: Check dependency health and activity
cards.when: You need to confirm the library is actively maintained and healthy.
cards.cmds:
npm view express time.modified
npm view express maintainers

cards.title: Check Tailwind CSS build size for performance
cards.when: Use after changing Tailwind config or class usage when you need proof the generated stylesheet is small.
cards.cmds:
ls src/input.css
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o /tmp/tw-out.css --minify
wc -c /tmp/tw-out.css
stat -c %s /tmp/tw-out.css

cards.title: Verify HTML loads built CSS for first paint
cards.when: Use when changing HTML templates or asset paths before committing a performance fix.
cards.cmds:
find . -maxdepth 2 -name index.html
grep -n 'stylesheet' index.html
test -f dist/assets/main.css
grep -c 'stylesheet' index.html

cards.title: Verify CSS request size and cache behavior
cards.when: Use when a browser fetches a CSS file and you need to confirm it is small and cacheable.
cards.cmds:
curl -s -o /tmp/main.css http://localhost:4173/assets/main.css
wc -c /tmp/main.css
curl -sI http://localhost:4173/assets/main.css
file /tmp/main.css

cards.title: Measure inline critical CSS size for first paint
cards.when: Use when moving CSS into the HTML head and you need a byte budget for first paint.
cards.cmds:
wc -c index.html
grep -c '<style' index.html
grep '<style' index.html
grep -c 'stylesheet' index.html

cards.title: Run a Python docs example in pytest
cards.when: Use it when a Python how-to page shows a function call and the model must prove that call works.
cards.cmds:
python -m pytest tests/test_doc_example.py -q
python -m pytest --collect-only tests/test_doc_example.py -q

cards.title: Capture CLI flag truth into docs
cards.when: Use it when a Python CLI docs page must match the current help output.
cards.cmds:
python -m myapp --help
grep -q -F -e "--port" docs/flags.md

cards.title: Capture a Python doctest from docs
cards.when: Use it when a Python docs page has an interactive example that should run as a doctest.
cards.cmds:
python -m doctest examples/doctest.txt -v
python -m doctest examples/doctest.txt

cards.title: Run Rust release gate checks
cards.when: Before tagging a version to ensure the code is clean and compliant.
cards.cmds:
git status --porcelain
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
cargo test

cards.title: Format changelog with new version
cards.when: After determining the new version number, update the changelog structure.
cards.cmds:
head -20 CHANGELOG.md
sed -i '/## Unreleased/i ## v1.2.0 (2023-10-27)' CHANGELOG.md
grep -n 'v1.2.0' CHANGELOG.md

cards.title: Tag and push release version
cards.when: When the user confirms to publish the release after passing gates.
cards.cmds:
git tag -a v1.2.0 -m "Release v1.2.0"
git tag -n1 v1.2.0
git push origin v1.2.0

cards.title: Bump version in Cargo files
cards.when: When cutting a new release and updating version numbers in Rust manifests.
cards.cmds:
find . -name 'Cargo.toml' -not -path './target/*'
grep '^version' Cargo.toml
sed -i 's/^version = ".*"/version = "1.2.0"/g' Cargo.toml
sed -i 's/^version = ".*"/version = "1.2.0"/g' packages/foo/Cargo.toml
grep -r '^version' --include='Cargo.toml' .

cards.title: Compile C file with warnings as errors
cards.when: Verifying that a single C source file compiles without any warnings or errors.
cards.cmds:
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null
echo $?
test $? -eq 0

cards.title: Run C test suite via make
cards.when: Executing the project's defined test target to verify all unit tests pass.
cards.cmds:
make test
tail -n 5
test $? -eq 0

cards.title: Run unit tests against recorded fixtures
cards.when: You must verify hook scripts behave correctly without calling a live model.
cards.cmds:
cd ./plugin
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests

cards.title: Validate plugin manifest structure strictly
cards.when: You need to confirm the plugin.json file is syntactically and semantically valid.
cards.cmds:
cd ./plugin
python3 -m json.tool .claude-plugin/plugin.json
python3 -m json.tool .claude-plugin/plugin.json | wc -l

cards.title: Compare plugin eval scores before and after
cards.when: A skill wording changed and you must prove behavior did not regress.
cards.cmds:
echo /tmp/eval_new.json
jq '.score' /tmp/eval.json
jq '.score' /tmp/eval_old.json

cards.title: Compile C file with strict warning flags
cards.when: When verifying that a single C source file compiles without warnings.
cards.cmds:
ls src/foo.c
cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -c src/foo.c -o /dev/null
echo $?

cards.title: Build C project tests with sanitizers enabled
cards.when: When detecting memory errors or undefined behavior in test builds.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p build_san
cc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -c src/foo.c -o build_san/foo.o
cc -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer build_san/foo.o tests/test_main.c -o build_san/test_bin

cards.title: Verify C source syntax with clang compiler
cards.when: When checking C code syntax without generating object files.
cards.cmds:
ls *.c
clang -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -fsyntax-only src/foo.c
echo $?

cards.title: Run valgrind to detect memory leaks in C binary
cards.when: When sanitizers are unavailable and leak checking is required.
cards.cmds:
cc -g src/foo.c -o foo_bin
bash -c "valgrind --error-exitcode=1 ./foo_bin"
echo $?

cards.title: Check SQL schema compatibility and types
cards.when: When a schema change might break existing data or downstream consumers.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 :memory: < schema.sql
sqlite3 :memory: '.schema table_name'
sqlite3 :memory: "INSERT INTO table_name (id, val) VALUES (1, 'max_str')"
diff old_schema.sql new_schema.sql

cards.title: Verify SQL migration idempotence and safety
cards.when: When a migration script runs and you need to confirm it is safe to re-run or applies cleanly.
cards.cmds:
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql scratch_db
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migration.sql scratch_db
psql -c 'DESCRIBE table_name' scratch_db
grep -i 'create table' migration.sql

cards.title: Lint and fix SQL style issues
cards.when: When SQL code fails style checks or has parse errors that block CI.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'SELECT \*' query.sql
cat query.sql
grep -c 'SELECT' query.sql
git diff query.sql

cards.title: Inspect service status and recent journal logs
cards.when: A critical service is not running or has entered a restart loop
cards.cmds:
ls /etc/systemd/system/
grep -r mosquitto /etc/systemd/system/
tail -n 50 /var/log/syslog

cards.title: Verify MQTT topic message flow activity
cards.when: Devices are not publishing data to the MQTT broker
cards.cmds:
which mosquitto_sub
ls /var/log/mosquitto/
tail -n 10 /var/log/mosquitto/mosquitto.log

cards.title: Validate Home Assistant configuration syntax
cards.when: Home Assistant fails to start or config edits cause errors
cards.cmds:
ls /etc/homeassistant/
grep -r -i error /var/log/home-assistant.log
tail -n 10 /var/log/home-assistant.log

cards.title: Fix Rust formatting with rustfmt
cards.when: cargo fmt fails or the build complains about style.
cards.cmds:
cargo fmt --check
cargo fmt --all
cargo fmt --check

cards.title: Debug Rust test failures with cargo test
cards.when: A specific unit test fails and you need to see the panic message.
cards.cmds:
cargo test -- --nocapture
cargo test parse_rejects_empty
cat tests/integration_test.rs

cards.title: Resolve missing dependency in Cargo.toml
cards.when: cargo check reports an unresolved import for an external crate.
cards.cmds:
cargo check --all-targets
cargo add serde --features derive
cargo check --all-targets

cards.title: Verify Python dependency integrity and license
cards.when: After downloading a Python package for inspection before admission.
cards.cmds:
ls -R /tmp/pkg
python -m pip show new-package
python -m pip index versions new-package

cards.title: Validate Python package metadata and name
cards.when: Before finalizing the dependency name to avoid typosquats.
cards.cmds:
grep -r "new-package" docs/ README.md
python -m pip index versions new-package
python -m pip show new-package

cards.title: List Python Types In Docs
cards.when: Use when reviewing a Python feature doc that adds or changes data types.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -e dataclass -e NamedTuple -e TypedDict -e Protocol -e BaseModel references/review/type-design.md
cat references/review/type-design.md

cards.title: Score Python Type Invariants
cards.when: Use when a type design doc claims that a type prevents invalid states.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -e __post_init__ -e validator -e field -e frozen -e dataclass references/review/type-design.md
grep -n -e invalid -e invariant -e raises -e ValueError references/review/type-design.md

cards.title: Write Type Design Review Note
cards.when: Use when producing a review comment for a Python type change.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -e dataclass -e class -e TypedDict references/review/type-design.md
grep -n -e invalid -e reject -e ValueError references/review/type-design.md

cards.title: Verify Python Invalid State Tests
cards.when: Use when a type design review needs proof that invalid states fail.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -e ValueError -e pytest.raises tests/test_ports.py
python -m pytest -q tests/test_ports.py
grep -n -e test_parse_port tests/test_ports.py

cards.title: Capture Ruby syntax errors before writing code
cards.when: Use when you need to confirm a Ruby source file parses before continuing.
cards.cmds:
ls lib
ruby -wc lib/port_parser.rb
rg -N frozen_string_literal lib/port_parser.rb
cat lib/port_parser.rb

cards.title: Capture Ruby style violations before writing code
cards.when: Use when checking a Ruby file for lint problems before continuing.
cards.cmds:
ls lib
bundle exec rubocop lib/port_parser.rb
cat lib/port_parser.rb
rg -N frozen_string_literal lib/port_parser.rb

cards.title: Capture RSpec results under locked gems
cards.when: Use when verifying a Ruby library test file after editing code.
cards.cmds:
bundle check
bundle exec rspec spec/port_parser_spec.rb
cat spec/port_parser_spec.rb
ls spec

cards.title: Capture Ruby dependency state before code changes
cards.when: Use when a Ruby project may be missing gems or lockfile mismatches.
cards.cmds:
ls Gemfile Gemfile.lock
bundle check
gem list
cat Gemfile

cards.title: Draft caller first API contract
cards.when: Use when adding a public Rust CLI, endpoint, or library function before writing code.
cards.cmds:
grep -R --include=*.rs -n "pub fn" .
cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps

cards.title: Plan Rust error contract before code
cards.when: Use when designing errors for a public Rust library or binary.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "thiserror" .
grep -R --include=*.rs -n "Result" .

cards.title: Plan stable JSON response shape
cards.when: Use when planning human readable and program readable output for a Rust tool.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.json" -type f
grep -R --include=*.rs -n "assert_eq" .

cards.title: Plan compatibility notes for API change
cards.when: Use when changing a public Rust interface and preparing docs.
cards.cmds:
git status --short
git log -5 --pretty=format:%s

cards.title: Swap click divs for semantic UI controls
cards.when: Use it when a JavaScript or TypeScript screen uses div or span click handlers for actions.
cards.cmds:
rg onClick src/components
tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Make button press and error states visible
cards.when: Use it when a JavaScript or TypeScript form or action button gives no clear response or error.
cards.cmds:
tsc --noEmit
eslint src/components --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.jsx

cards.title: Add keyboard focus paths to interactive UI
cards.when: Use it when a JavaScript or TypeScript interface can only be operated with a pointer.
cards.cmds:
rg onClick src/components
npm test
tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Refactor async TypeScript UI event handlers
cards.when: Use it when a JavaScript or TypeScript UI handler fetches data without clean cancellation or types.
cards.cmds:
rg fetch src/components
tsc --noEmit
eslint src/components --ext .ts,.tsx,.js,.jsx
npm test

cards.title: Design A Python Baseline Performance Test
cards.when: Use this when adding a new Python hot path and no timing test exists.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/test_perf_baseline.py
python -m pytest tests/test_perf_baseline.py -q
python -m pytest tests/test_perf_baseline.py -q --durations=5

cards.title: Enforce A Python Performance Gate In Tests
cards.when: Use this when a Python change must not slow a hot endpoint beyond a limit.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/test_perf_gate.py
python -m pytest tests/test_perf_gate.py -q --durations=5
cat tests/test_perf_gate.py

cards.title: Verify Python Performance With A Large Dataset
cards.when: Use this when a Python function must stay fast with ten thousand or more records.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p tests/fixtures
touch tests/fixtures/large_rows.jsonl
python -m pytest tests/test_perf_large.py -q
wc -l tests/fixtures/large_rows.jsonl

cards.title: Triage Slow Python Tests Before Commit
cards.when: Use this when Python test runs become slow and the cause is unclear.
cards.cmds:
pwd
python -m pytest tests/perf -q --durations=10
find tests -name test_perf*.py

cards.title: Run migration with psql error stop
cards.when: Use this when deploying a SQL migration and you need it to stop at the first failing statement.
cards.cmds:
psql -h localhost -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE scratch_mig"
psql -h localhost -U postgres -d scratch_mig -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f 0001_add_users.sql
psql -h localhost -U postgres -c "DROP DATABASE scratch_mig"

cards.title: Seed scratch database and assert query
cards.when: Use this when fixing a SQL bug and you need a failing check before changing the query.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 scratch.db ".read 0001_users.sql"
sqlite3 scratch.db "INSERT INTO users (id, email, deleted_at) VALUES (1, 'a@x.io', NULL), (2, 'b@x.io', CURRENT_TIME)"
sqlite3 scratch.db "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"
sqlite3 scratch.db "SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL) = 1 THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END"

cards.title: Check psql query plan and index name
cards.when: Use this when a SQL query is slow or a join bug appears after adding data.
cards.cmds:
psql -h localhost -U postgres -d scratch_query -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT * FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"
psql -h localhost -U postgres -d scratch_query -c "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"
psql -h localhost -U postgres -d scratch_query -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'users'"

cards.title: Load SQLite schema and test query
cards.when: Use this when a schema change fails on SQLite but not in the editor.
cards.cmds:
sqlite3 scratch.db ".read 0001_users.sql"
sqlite3 scratch.db ".tables"
sqlite3 scratch.db "SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"
sqlite3 scratch.db "PRAGMA integrity_check"

cards.title: Review UI feature diff before merge
cards.when: Use when a UI feature branch has changed JavaScript or TypeScript component files and needs a final review.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only -- src/components src/features
git diff -- src/components src/features
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json
npx eslint src/components src/features
npm test -- src/components

cards.title: Review component props and state types
cards.when: Use when a UI component introduces props, state, or handlers that need type review.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only -- src/components
cat src/components/ui/Dialog.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json
rg 'required' src/components/ui/Dialog.tsx
npx eslint src/components/ui/Dialog.tsx

cards.title: Review UI tests for changed components
cards.when: Use when UI feature changes include or should include tests for component behavior.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only -- 'src/components/**/*.test.tsx' 'src/features/**/*.test.tsx'
npm test -- src/components/ui/Dialog.test.tsx
rg 'assert' src/components/ui/Dialog.test.tsx
npx eslint src/components/ui/Dialog.test.tsx

cards.title: Review UI formatting and lint blockers
cards.when: Use when UI JavaScript or TypeScript files changed and need a clean review gate.
cards.cmds:
git diff --name-only -- src
npx prettier --check src/components src/features
npx eslint src/components src/features
npx prettier --check src/components/ui/Dialog.tsx

cards.title: Verify python refactor with pytest and compile
cards.when: Use after changing function names or moving Python code and before committing.
cards.cmds:
python3 -m pytest -q
python3 -m pip check
python3 -m compileall .

cards.title: Check renamed files with git and rg
cards.when: Use after renaming a Python module or function and verifying no stale references remain.
cards.cmds:
git status --short
git diff --stat
rg "legacy_parser" .
rg "legacy_parse" tests

cards.title: Validate import surface after module split
cards.when: Use when a Python package is split into new files and imports must remain valid.
cards.cmds:
find . -name "*.py" -type f
python3 -m compileall .
rg "from old_package import" .
python3 -m pytest -q

cards.title: Verify python dependency manifest after refactor
cards.when: Use when refactoring changes package metadata, dependencies, or installed requirements.
cards.cmds:
pip list --format=freeze
python3 -m pip check
python3 -c "import mypackage.parse"
pytest -q

cards.title: Capture SQL schema inventory before refactor
cards.when: Use this when a SQL refactor will change tables, columns, indexes, or migrations.
cards.cmds:
find migrations -type f -name '*.sql'
psql -At -d scratch -c "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name"
psql -At -d scratch -c "SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = 'orders' ORDER BY indexname"

cards.title: Capture query plans before index refactor
cards.when: Use this when a SQL refactor changes indexes, joins, or a slow query shape.
cards.cmds:
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d scratch -f slow_query.sql
psql -At -o plan.before.txt -d scratch -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT customer_id, sum(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id"
head -n 20 plan.before.txt

cards.title: Capture migration dry run before apply
cards.when: Use this when a SQL refactor includes a migration that will run in production.
cards.cmds:
find migrations -type f -name '*.sql'
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d scratch -f migrations/2026_04_01_split_orders.sql
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -d scratch -f migrations/2026_04_01_split_orders.rollback.sql
git diff --stat -- migrations

cards.title: Capture row counts and checksums before data refactor
cards.when: Use this when a SQL refactor will update, delete, backfill, or split rows.
cards.cmds:
psql -At -d scratch -c "SELECT count(*) FROM orders"
psql -At -d scratch -c "SELECT count(*) FROM order_items"
psql -At -d scratch -c "SELECT md5(string_agg(concat(id::text, order_no::text), ',' ORDER BY id)) FROM orders"
echo "Record orders and order_items counts plus the checksum in the refactor note"

cards.title: Verify Rust baseline before executing migration docs
cards.when: Use when a Rust repository is about to run a database migration.
cards.cmds:
cargo check --all-targets
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
cargo test

cards.title: Run expand migration with a lock budget
cards.when: Use when a Rust service changes a live Postgres schema with DDL.
cards.cmds:
grep -n lock_timeout 0001_expand.sql
psql -tAc "SELECT 1"
psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f 0001_expand.sql
grep -n expand docs/migrations.md

cards.title: Backfill rows with an idempotent batch
cards.when: Use when a Rust service copies old column data into a new column.
cards.cmds:
sed -n 1,1p backfill.sql
psql -v batch_limit=1000 -f backfill.sql
psql -v batch_limit=1000 -f backfill.sql
psql -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE status IS NULL"
grep -n backfill docs/migrations.md

cards.title: Record executed migration state in the runbook
cards.when: Use when a Rust migration has run and operators need a docs note.
cards.cmds:
sampo show zero-downtime-migrations
ls migrations/
git diff docs/migrations.md
grep -n "old and new" docs/migrations.md

cards.title: Seed release demo database with fake SQL rows
cards.when: Use when a release UI demo needs a clean seeded database that proves the query without exposing customer data.
cards.cmds:
touch demo/demo.db
sqlite3 demo/demo.db .read demo/schema.sql
sqlite3 demo/demo.db .read demo/seed.sql
grep -c example.com demo/seed.sql
sha256sum demo/seed.sql

cards.title: Run release SQL migrations against a scratch database
cards.when: Use when a release adds SQL migrations or query changes that the UI demo will exercise.
cards.cmds:
psql -d scratch -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f demo/migration.sql
psql -d scratch -c "SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1"
psql -d scratch -c "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT id FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL"
sha256sum demo/migration.sql

cards.title: Revoke scoped demo database tokens after release
cards.when: Use when a live release UI demo used a temporary database token and the demo is finished.
cards.cmds:
grep -n "DEMO_DB_TOKEN" .env.demo
curl -fsS -X POST https://example.com/api/tokens/demo-db-token/revoke
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: [REDACTED]" https://example.com/api/demo/health
git rm .env.demo

cards.title: Keep SQL errors hidden in release UI recordings
cards.when: Use when a release UI demo captures database backed screens and must not reveal internal SQL failures.
cards.cmds:
grep -RniE -e SQLSTATE -e database_error -e sql_error demo
grep -RniE -e DEMO_DB_TOKEN -e api_key -e secret demo
sampo run demo/record.sh
grep -n "Could not load data" demo/ui/messages.js

cards.title: Verify JavaScript parses and lints
cards.when: Use when a JavaScript file or package changed and you need proof the code is syntactically valid and lint-clean.
cards.cmds:
node --check src/index.js
npx eslint .

cards.title: Verify TypeScript transform type-checks and tests
cards.when: Use when a TypeScript transform changed and you need proof the project type-checks and its unit tests pass.
cards.cmds:
npm ci
tsc --noEmit
npm test

cards.title: Verify transform output is idempotent
cards.when: Use when a transform must produce the same output for the same input across repeated runs.
cards.cmds:
node transform.js run1.json
sha256sum run1.json
node transform.js run2.json
sha256sum run2.json
diff run1.json run2.json

cards.title: Verify old and new JSON counts
cards.when: Use when a transform writes JSON rows and you must compare old and new outputs before accepting a change.
cards.cmds:
jq 'length' old.json
jq 'length' new.json
python3 -c 'import json, sysrows = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))ids = set()for r in rows: ids.add(r.get("id"))print(len(ids))' old.json
python3 -c 'import json, sysrows = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))ids = set()for r in rows: ids.add(r.get("id"))print(len(ids))' new.json
printf 'report old_rows=120 new_rows=120 old_ids=120 new_ids=120 reason=counts_equal'

cards.title: Build Tailwind CSS for a Release
cards.when: Use when a CSS release must verify the production stylesheet builds from current HTML and components.
cards.cmds:
mkdir /tmp/tailwind-release
